<answer>Colorado</answer>

### [**The Steadman Clinic**]

[October 8, 2024] · 

![Image 1: 🌟] Event Recap: Life After Joint Replacement Hike with Dr. Raymond Kim ![Image 2: 🌟]

We enjoyed an inspiring day on the trails with Dr. Ray Kim and 67 of his amazing patients during our Annual Life After Joint Replacement Hike! Dr. Kim hosts this annual event to celebrate the remarkable journeys of his patients following joint replacement surgery.

The group gathered in Lionshead to take on the beautiful, yet challenging, 3.3-mile Berry Picker Trail up Vail Mountain. After reaching the summit, participants enjoyed a well-deserved gondola ride down, followed by a celebratory lunch on Garfinkel’s deck with breathtaking views.

The day was filled with heartfelt stories of recovery and transformation. Many patients shared how their joint replacement surgeries have given them a new lease on life, allowing them to stay active and keep doing what they love

Thank you to everyone who joined us for this special event! We can’t wait for Dr. Kim’s Annual Ski Day this winter! ![Image 3: 🎿]
